posts.name: drstein
posts.cooked:
Christopher:

La Capitan is a lady!And, yes, I know my Spanish. Pretty darn well, actually. But playing with proper spellings and such is how heroes and villains are named!

By the way: La capitan is actually correct. Indeed the word "La capitana, la doctora, la presidenta" exists, but those are only very recent. Previously no one thought that women could have these ranks, hence you would use "La capitan, la doctor, la presidente, etc…" for the unlikely event in which it happened. Since the change is so recent, the older namings are still correct. Specially if she comes from a long time ago or a universe in which things have not equaly evolved
